title: Jeremiah (Christian Bible)
dateDisplay: Composed over several centuries in the first millennium BCE; the Masoretic text is attested from the 10th century CE
attributionNote: The text is anonymous or traditionally attributed; the attribution is part of the work's reception rather than a statement about the surviving author. The catalogue does not adjudicate it.
description: Warnings before Jerusalem's fall and the promise of a new covenant. This is the book as received in Christian Bibles: the Westminster Leningrad Codex Hebrew text beside the King James Version of 1611.
historicalContext: Prophetic oracles and narratives from the Assyrian, Babylonian and Persian periods.
availabilityNote: Streamed from the Bolls Bible API. Verse references follow the KJV; where the Hebrew counts a psalm superscription as verse 1, the original-language pane is one verse ahead.
